## Key Projects & Architecture

- [ScanForge](https://github.com/sanketpatel32/ScanForge): Production-ready DAST platform for REST APIs automating OWASP API Top 10 security scanning with safe/balanced/aggressive scan modes, Bun runners, BullMQ queue monitoring, and multi-tenant workspace isolation.
- [mdpeek](https://github.com/sanketpatel32/Mdpeek): Lightweight Windows desktop Markdown viewer and editor built with Tauri 2 and Rust with live preview, multi-tab editing, Mermaid/KaTeX support (~5.5 MB installer).
- [AuraFlow](https://github.com/sanketpatel32/Portal): Self-hosted developer utility portal with 16 integrated developer tools (API testing, SQL/NoSQL clients, real-time Kanban board, cron triggers) powered by Bun, React 19, and WebSockets. Live at https://portal.sanketpatel.online
- [Salon Management App](https://github.com/sanketpatel32/fresha-salon-app): Full-stack salon booking platform with JWT authentication, role-based workflows, CashFree payment integration, Socket.io real-time updates, and automated reminders.
